scope: Sapporo snow festival and Osaka Glico revisions, Europe 28 including existing Paris, USA 10 and Middle East 6 dedicated illustrations

cities.name: 삿포로
cities.scene: Sapporo with the atmosphere of the Sapporo Snow Festival: snow-covered Odori Park, a large architectural snow-castle sculpture and pale-blue ice sculptures as the main foreground, the recognizable red Sapporo TV Tower behind them, snow-covered trees, and restrained warm festival lights. The winter festival and snow sculptures must read clearly at small size

cities.name: 오사카
cities.scene: Osaka's Dotonbori canal and Ebisu Bridge with the recognizable Glico Running Man billboard clearly visible as a primary landmark on the canal-side facade. Make the white-clad runner with both arms raised, the red circle, blue running-track background, and the word "グリコ" recognizable, large enough to read as the Glico sign inside a small header. Include the lively canal-side buildings, canal reflections and a small sightseeing boat. Integrate the billboard as part of the drawn scene
